youtube_description:
Jesus... I saw my dad sitting alone in the park at noon today. He told us he was at work.

He saw his dad alone in the park at noon. His dad lost his job and still leaves in his office shirt every morning so the family won't find out.

Him: Jesus... I saw my dad sitting alone in the park at noon today. He told us he was at work.

Him: He lost his job. He's been leaving in his office shirt every morning so we won't find out.

Jesus: He isn't lying to hurt you. He's trying to carry it alone so you won't have to.

Him: But I'm not a kid anymore. Why won't he just tell me?

Jesus: Because to him, being your dad means being strong. Right now he feels like he's failing at the thing he cares about most.

Him: So what do I do? Pretend I never saw him?

Jesus: Tonight, just sit with him. You don't need the right words. Let him know he doesn't have to hold this by himself.

"God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble."
Psalms 46:1 (NIV)

Jesus: His strength was never supposed to come from a job. It comes from Me.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.
